summary: Surface-to-surface 2x2 pixel averaging blend (structural twin of sub_503920). Iterates a 16-bit source surface (this[0]) in row pairs: for each row it reads a 2x2 neighborhood of 16-bit pixels (source pixel base at obj+0x18, offsets 0x0 and 0x2 for the two column samples plus the next-row pair at the row base + obj+0x1050), computes a box average per byte channel (byte 0 selected with mask 0xFFFF00FF, byte 1 selected with mask 0xFF00) with rounding constants 2 and 512 and right-shift 2, combines the channels with an XOR, and writes the 16-bit result to the destination surface (this[1]). Both surfaces advance row by row by their row strides (obj+0x1050 source, 4176 on the destination) until the row count bound obj+0x105C is exhausted; the per-row width bound comes from obj+0x1058. Returns 0.

operations.description: Load the source surface pointer from this[0] and the destination surface pointer from this[1]; read the source pixel base at obj+0x18, the source row stride at obj+0x1050 (4176), and the end bound at obj+0x105C (4188) computed as base + row stride * row count.

Outer loop over source row blocks: while the source pixel pointer stays below the end bound (obj+0x105C), process one source row against the destination row, then advance the destination row by its stride (4176 on this[1]) and the source row by the source row stride obj+0x1050.
Compute the per-row inner bound from the width field: v28 = source row pointer + obj+0x1058 (4184).

Inner loop reads a 2x2 neighborhood of 16-bit source pixels per output pixel: A at source offset 0x0, B at source offset 0x2, C at the next-row pointer (row base + obj+0x1050) offset 0x0, D at next-row offset 0x2; the loop advances two source bytes per iteration until the inner bound is reached.

Box average of the four 16-bit pixels with byte-channel separation: byte 0 (low 8 bits, selected via mask 0xFFFF00FF and the byte cast) summed with rounding constant 2 and shifted right 2; byte 1 (mask 0xFF00) summed with rounding constant 512 and shifted right 2; the two channel averages are combined with an XOR into the output 16-bit value.
Write the computed 16-bit average to the destination row and advance the destination pointer by two bytes.
Return 0 after processing all row blocks; there are no failure paths.
Invoked as the case-51 compositing handler from COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod (0x00504B37).
